title: 倒装句
explanation:
## 倒装句:把谓语提到主语前

英语句子的常规语序是"主 + 谓",把谓语(或助动词)提到主语前,就构成倒装。倒装分两类:**全部倒装**(整个谓语提前)和**部分倒装**(助动词/情态动词提前)。

## 部分倒装的触发词

1. **否定词放句首**:never, hardly, seldom, not only, no sooner...than 等。Never have I seen such a view(我从未见过这样的景色)。
2. **Only + 状语放句首**:Only in this way can we succeed。
3. **So/Neither/Nor 表"也"**:He likes coffee, so do I;She can't swim, neither can I。

## 全部倒装

1. **here/there 开头的方位词**:Here comes the bus(车来了);There goes the bell(铃响了)。
2. **介词短语/副词放句首**:On the top of the hill stands an old temple。

## 高频考点

1. 倒装句中助动词时态要与原句一致:Hardly had I left when it rained(注意 had 提前,主句用过去完成)。
2. not only...but also 连接主语时不倒装:Not only he but also I am wrong。
3. so 用于"确实如此"时不倒装:He is clever, so he is(他确实很聪明)。

examples.en: Never have I met such a kind person.
examples.cn: 我从未遇到过这么善良的人。
examples.note: 否定词 Never 放句首,助动词 have 提前,部分倒装。

examples.en: Only after the storm did the sky clear.
examples.note: Only + 状语放句首,助动词 did 提前。
here 放句首,全部倒装,主语 the teacher 后置。

examples.en: She can dance, and so can her sister.
examples.note: so + 助动词 + 主语,表"也如此"。

errors.wrong: Never I have seen such a movie.
errors.right: Never have I seen such a movie.
errors.note: 否定词放句首必须部分倒装,助动词提前。

errors.wrong: Only by working hard we can succeed.
errors.right: Only by working hard can we succeed.
errors.note: Only + 状语放句首,情态动词 can 要提前。
here 放句首时全部倒装,谓语 comes 提前。

quiz.note: 否定词放句首,助动词提前:Never have I eaten。

quiz.q: Only when he returned ___ the truth.
quiz.note: Only + 从句放句首,主句倒装:did he know。

quiz.q: He is a teacher, and ___ his wife.
quiz.note: so + be 动词 + 主语,表"也"。

quiz.q: Hardly ___ the airport when the plane took off.
quiz.note: Hardly...when 句型,主句倒装用过去完成时。

quiz.q: Not only ___ the exam, but he also got full marks.
quiz.note: not only 放句首,前半句部分倒装。
